integrity: The claim is supported by a standalone exhaustive verifier that constructs the channel relation in two equivalent ways, enumerates every size-five clique, excludes size six, and recomputes all stated orbit, membership, and coverage statistics from the packaged complete census.
scientific_limitations: Finite exact classification only for binary length seven and exactly two deletions. The scalar optimum 5 is prior work; the result classifies its equality layer and a natural output-coverage refinement. The stated symmetry group is only reversal and global complement, not the full graph automorphism group. An unindexed historical census remains a residual originality risk.
title: Complete equality census for binary length-seven two-deletion codes
